answer: Reputation-weighted audit lottery.** Each identity accrues an audit debt proportional to its transaction volume; a random subset is audited, and a failed audit freezes all its linked balances. Honest agents amortize audit cost across genuine activity, while a sybil cluster pays full audit cost per clone, making fake volume expensive. A hollow identity with no real trades still owes the same per-identity fee. Clones beyond the first face an umber surcharge on each debt. Growth is capped per island of related identities.
